body:
there's scss too, but it's in a different repo than this one. We didn't know that people were consuming the scss directly. I'll make a change so the Instantsearch.css repository also exposes scss @jameswagoner. In the mean time I put it all up on a temporary gist:

https://gist.github.com/Haroenv/8cdcd08bc81276cfc98790b1ffaea3dd

The reason it's only two files is because that's the way we've been working, we wanted to keep the styling more minimal in this version to favour overridability.
